[NCBK.6.7] **Neither cooldown nor supersede is the integrator's.** The engine
suppresses a call inside its cooldown window ([LCRS.8.2]), and retracts the
prior response fact and `CallError` ([LCRS.6.2.1]), before the call reaches the
call callback. When the integrator asserts an answer, the engine retracts the
earlier live answer with the same correlation first ([LCRS.6.2.4]). A
response's lifetime is its schema's TTL ([LCRS.6.6.1]): the integrator asserts a
response with `ds_engine_assert` and supplies no TTL of its own.
